subject: Brightwell DSR: evidence request, SCCs, and controller/processor alignment
messages:
From: Devon Hughes <devon.hughes@brightwell.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightwell.com>, privacy@brightwell.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Brightwell DSR: access/delete process & controller/processor clarification

Hi Soojin,

We've received a batch of data subject requests from patients (access + erasure) tied to Brightwell's pilot. Before we start provisioning exports, legal needs a short evidence package that shows:
- who is the controller vs processor for the affected datasets under our DPA/SCCs,
- a short export/delete playbook and timestamps we can provide to the requesters, and
- copies of SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ summary pages you can share with our compliance team.

Can Redwood confirm whether you will be treated purely as processor for the pilot data, or if any telemetry/derived analytics are treated as controller activity? Also, can you provide signed SCCs and a timeline for producing an evidence bundle?

Attached is an example DSR from our side (redacted).

Thanks,
Devon
Devon Hughes
Ops Lead, Brightwell Health
attachments: example_access_request.json (redacted)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Devon Hughes <devon.hughes@brightwell.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Brightwell DSR: access/delete process & controller/processor clarification

Devon —

Thanks for the note and the example DSR. Looping in Neha (Privacy/Legal) and Karthik (Platform) so we can give a concise package and proposed timeline. Quick answers up-front:
- Contractually under the DPA and current SOW, Redwood is a processor for customer data Brightwell ingests via the Hosted API.
- We do process certain service telemetry (metrics/usage) that the platform generates; for clarity we treat that telemetry as "service-processing metadata" under the DPA (processor role). We will not assert controller obligations over primary patient records Brightwell provides.

Next steps from our side:
1) Neha to propose the evidence list + drafted statement of roles (SCC reference).
2) Karthik to produce timing for exports and deletion primitives and the proof artifacts we can share (audit logs, export manifest, deletion confirmation).
3) I'll collect SOC2/SIG/CAIQ summary pages and share signed SCCs if available.

Proposed timeline: deliver initial evidence bundle by end of day 2027-05-04, follow-up call 2027-05-05 if you need walkthrough.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415 555 0192

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Hughes <devon.hughes@brightwell.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightwell.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Brightwell DSR: access/delete process & controller/processor clarification

Thanks — adding a short legal-ready statement below you can share with Brightwell. I'm attaching a mutual action plan template so we can track requests and responsibilities.

Draft statement of roles (to include in evidence):
- Under the existing DPA and executed SCCs, Brightwell Health is the data controller for patient records ingested into Redwood-hosted endpoints. Redwood Inference acts as a data processor that processes data on Brightwell's behalf and only acts on documented instructions.
- Redwood may process operational telemetry necessary to provide and improve the service; such telemetry is limited in scope and processed as a processor.

Requested documents I can provide:
- Signed SCCs (if not already executed) — please confirm which SCC annex Brightwell needs; we can provide EU standard SCCs countersigned.
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) — attached.
- SIG+ self-assessment summary and CAIQ highlights — we will include redacted answers to the DSR-relevant controls.

Attachments: Brightwell_DSR_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

I recommend we include a simple mutual action plan row per DSR (request id, requester id, data ranges, requested action, party responsibility, evidence artifacts, completion timestamp).

-Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Hughes <devon.hughes@brightwell.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Brightwell DSR: access/delete process & controller/processor clarification

Hi all — technical note on evidence artifacts we can produce and expected timelines:

What we can produce (artifacts):
- Export manifest (JSON) listing objects, sizes, checksums, and request id — suitable for access responses.
- Audit log slices showing the export job creation and the S3 presigned URL issuance (timestamped).
- Deletion confirmation: background job entry + object tombstone marker (we can provide a signed statement and a log extract).
- Access log: API call history (IP, user-agent, request id) for the subject id (we'll need Brightwell to provide canonical user identifier).

Timelines:
- Small export (single user): 1–2 hours to run, packaging + signatures within 4 hours.
- Bulk erasure job (1000+ records): depends on object count — estimate 4–24 hours; we will provide a rolling completion report.

Notes on controller/processor edge cases:
- If Brightwell configures server-side model observability hooks that store PII in a Brightwell-managed sink, Brightwell remains controller for that sink.
- If Redwood is asked to persist derived datasets outside the per-customer namespace (rare), we need a separate contract amendment; otherwise we do not persist patient PII beyond the customer namespace retention window.

Attachments referenced: DSR_export_proof.md (internal), KV_cache_retention.csv (internal examples).

-Karthik Iyer
Sr. Product Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Devon Hughes <devon.hughes@brightwell.com>

Appreciate the detail — that helps. A few follow-ups:
- Please confirm you can provide countersigned SCCs (we'll need a copy to attach to regulator correspondence).
- Can you include a sample export manifest (redacted) and an example deletion confirmation artifact in the bundle?
- We need access logs for three test subject IDs; can you confirm you require any additional identifiers beyond the user ids I've included in the spreadsheet?

If we can get the bundle by EOD 2027-05-04 that will work; otherwise overnight is OK but we prefer sooner.

Thanks,
Devon

Happy to hop on the call.

Best,
